scoring_justification: Power factor cannot be recomputed from raw artifacts without re-running the full numerical model; exact paper values are only given in figures. Structural checks (ordering, trend monotonicity, self-consistency) verify the main claim robustly.

outputs.description: The computed power factor and intermediate quantities for each (dE, N) pair. The checker will compare the power_factor values against hidden gold values from the paper and verify that for every dE the maximum power_factor among N>2 exceeds the power_factor at N=2.

output_contract.notes: The task is compute-driven; no external dataset is required. The scoring uses a result-level comparison (T0) with hidden paper values and an additional structural ordering check.

steps.description: Check structural ordering (max P(N>2) > P(N=2) for each dE), self-consistency (P ≈ σS²), and monotonic trends (Seebeck vs dE, conductivity vs N).
